why: THE CORPUS WITHOUT THIS FILE RUNS THIS UNIT'S BODY IN 217 CASES OF 8955.
Measured, not feared: harness/PreFilterMeasuredSignals.redtest.json is the
shipped translation with the whole body replaced by `return`, and it fails
217 of 8955. A case a no-op passes is a case that never got past
IF (ErrVar%aviFAIL < 0) THEN
RETURN
so 8738 of the 8955 cases compare the guard and nothing else, and a mutation
score on that corpus would be scored almost entirely on cases that return.
WHY, EXACTLY, AND IT IS THE SAME ARITHMETIC AS UNIT #37. R6 crosses the
quantities the reference's own predicates test. This unit has TEN, and its
own rule_coverage line says the cross product is 552,960 -- past
generate.py's _KNOB_CASE_LIMIT of 4096 -- so the block falls back to ALL
PAIRS, and in the fallback every knob not being crossed sits at the FIRST
value of its ladder. `ErrVar_aviFAIL`'s ladder is [-1, 0, 1, 2] and its
first value is -1: the arm that returns.
WHAT THIS FILE DOES ABOUT IT. R11 takes an admissible STATE and sweeps every
knob through every value with the rest of the state held admissible, so a
case in which aviFAIL is non-negative AND the rest of the configuration is
meaningful is expressible. That is ADDITION: the 8955 cases are still
generated and still compared, ranges.toml is untouched, and the generator
refused nothing -- it was never given a state to sweep from.
ADMISSIBILITY, PER FIELD, AGAINST THE REFERENCE RATHER THAN AGAINST TASTE.
Every unnamed varied parameter is inert-filled to 0 or 0.0, and for this
unit that is not merely uninformative, it is OUT OF BOUNDS: the five
objInst%inst* counters are subscripts into FP's DIMENSION(1024) arrays
inside the callees, and 0 is not a Fortran index. The same is true of
F_GenSpdNotch_Ind and F_TwrTopNotch_Ind, whose ELEMENTS subscript
F_NotchFreqs. All seven are named here for that reason and not for coverage.
iStatus IS 0 IN BOTH STATES, AND THAT IS THE ONLY WAY THE FILTERS ANSWER A
NUMBER. LocalVar%FP is a nested type the generator zero-initialises and does
not vary (the run reports it UNOBSERVABLE), so with iStatus /= 0 and
reset = .FALSE. every filter computes 1.0/FP%lpf1_a1(inst) * 0.0 on a zeroed
coefficient set -- NaN, identically on both sides. Unit #34 recorded the same
shape for LPFilter and left it open. iStatus = 0 takes the INITIALISATION arm,
which writes the coefficients from CornerFreq and DT before filtering, so the
compared outputs are finite. Time is 1.0 rather than 0.0 so that the
`iStatus == 0 .AND. Time == 0` zeroing branch is OFF at the baseline and R11's
own sweep of Time is what turns it on -- which is what makes the .AND.
observable rather than the two conditions being confounded.
THE TWO STATES ARE THE TWO CONFIGURATIONS THE 27 SCENARIOS DO NOT BOTH
REACH. State 1 is the shipped one: F_LPFType = 1, IPC_ControlMode > 0. State
2 is F_LPFType = 2 -- ZERO hits in all 27 scenarios -- together with
Flp_Mode = 2, whose blade-root SecLPFilter/HPFilter/notch arm only scenario 4
reaches and which the kernel's 62 captured cases never enter.
The frequencies and the signal magnitudes are the shipped NREL 5MW values
from Examples/DISCON.IN and the ranges a running simulation puts on those
channels; they are chosen to be admissible and to be distinct from each
other, not to reproduce any particular timestep.

states.name: lpf1_ipc_all_arms
states.why: F_LPFType=1, IPC_ControlMode=1, Flp_Mode=0, TD_Mode=1, one gen-speed notch and one tower-top notch. Every call in the unit executes: both speed LPFilters, the gen-speed notch loop, both SecLPFilters, both HPFilters, the tower-top notch loop (which iterates 0 times in all 27 scenarios), the TD_Mode HPFilter, the WSE LPFilter, NotchFilterSlopes on all three blades, both command SecLPFilters, both NacVane LPFilters and wrap_180.

states.name: lpf2_flap_mode_2
states.why: F_LPFType=2 and Flp_Mode=2 with IPC_ControlMode=0 -- the two arms no instrument in this campaign reaches. F_LPFType==2 has ZERO coverage hits in all 27 scenarios; the Flp_Mode==2 blade-root arm is scenario 4 only and is where this campaign's own fix to an upstream ROSCO indexing bug lives.
